title: Concept: Sandboxed frame keeps the same origin
description: A sandbox attribute that grants allow-same-origin in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A frame with both scripts and the same origin can remove its own sandbox, so the attribute stops being a boundary and the framed document shares the page's cookies.
applicability: Deployments that render a sandbox attribute that grants allow-same-origin into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A frame with both scripts and the same origin can remove its own sandbox, so the attribute stops being a boundary and the framed document shares the page's cookies.
